result.subject: Reminder: RSVP for Client dinner – Tier-1 UK bank
result.body:
Hi all,

Just a friendly nudge about the Client dinner – Tier-1 UK bank happening on Thursday 19 November at The Vault Room, Bank. If you haven’t already, please let us know whether you can join (yes or no) by Friday 13 November. The venue needs our final headcount by Tuesday 17 November, so a quick reply helps us lock in the details. Also, feel free to mention any dietary restrictions or accessibility needs in your response.

Thanks,
Business Operations
